senses.gloss:
निगड निगड, probably नि-गल् + अ, m. and n.
 1. An iron chain for the feet, Mṛcch. 97, 25.
 2. A fetter, Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 40.
निगडन निगडन, i. e. निगडय + अन, [] n. Putting in irons, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 11.
निगडय निगडय, a denomin. derived from निगड with अय, To put in irons, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 1.
निगद नि-गद् + अ, m. A prayer, Bhāg. P. 5, 3, 16.

निगम नि-गम् + अ, m.
 1. Holy writ, the Vedas, Man. 9, 19.
 2. A passage (of the Vedas), Chr. 9, 45.
 3. A precept, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 39.
 4. A merchant, Rām. 2, 125, 10 Gorr.
निगमिन् निगमिन्, i. e. निगम + इन्, adj. Versed in the Vedas, Bhāg. P. 4, 22, 47.
निगादिन् निगादिन्, i. e. नि-गद् + इन्, adj. Reciting, Suśr. 2, 158, 12.
निगूहन निगूहन, i. e. नि-गुह् + अन, n. Hiding, MBh. 3, 1404.

निगृहीतृ निगृहीतृ, i. e. a false form for नि-ग्रह् + ईतृ, m.
 1. One who lays hold on somebody, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 13.
 2. One who prevents somebody, Bhāg. P. 1, 12, 26.

निग्रह नि-ग्रह् + अ, m.
 1. Seizing, Mṛcch. 10, 21.
 2. Confinement, Bhāg. P. 8, 22, 21.
 3. Subduing, Man. 7, 175.
 4. Suppression, restraining, 6, 71; 302.
 5. Chastising, Kathās. 18, 36.
 6. A name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1179.
 --Comp.

निग्रहण निग्रहण, i. e. नि-ग्रह् + अन,
 I. adj. Suppressing, Suśr. 1, 155, 16.
 II. n.
 1. Suppression, Rām. 6, 99, 48.
 2. Punishment, MBh. 15, 230.
